about_the_game:
💊 Build a Drug Empire. Rule the Streets.

You're broke, unknown, and fresh in town—but not for long. Start from nothing and build your own criminal drug empire in a gritty open-world city crawling with cops, gangs, addicts, and opportunity.

Craft drugs, manage production, expand operations, and dominate your rivals. Whether you're cooking designer narcotics in a hidden lab or cutting cheap street junk for fast cash—it's all part of the hustle.

🔬 Cook, Cut, and Customize

Use a deep crafting system to produce a variety of drugs with unique effects and properties. Mix ingredients, discover secret recipes, and experiment with formulas to increase potency, addictiveness, or street value. Will you create premium designer substances or flood the streets with mass-market poison?

🚓 Evade the Law. Crush the Competition.

Police patrols, undercover agents, snitches, and rival dealers are everywhere. Manage your heat, disguise your deals, and always watch your back. Fight when necessary—or disappear before things get messy.

🛞 Smuggle Smart. Hide Your Heat.

Big shipments mean big profits—but also big risks. Hide your product inside car tires, fuel tanks, speaker systems, or custom compartments to sneak past checkpoints and patrols. Strip a car, stash your dope, seal it up, and roll out. Whether you play it safe with clever concealment or push your luck with speed and volume—the streets are watching, and one slip can cost you everything.

🧠 Grow Your Operation

Hire street dealers, rent stash houses, set up labs, and purchase legit-looking businesses as fronts. Automate distribution, manage your crew, and reinvest profits to scale up. Every choice affects your reputation, territory, and profit margins.

🤝 Solo Grind or Co-op Empire

Go it alone or team up in online co-op. Share labs, move product together, or backstab your partners when the stakes get high. Trust is optional—profit is everything.

🚬 Urban Drug Simulator with Real Grit

This is a no-fluff, no-fantasy drug simulator for players who want the full experience—risk, reward, and realism. Inspired by true crime, the streets don’t forgive mistakes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 - 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300 or similar
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 or Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 - 64-bit
  • Processor: 3.5GHz 6-Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3050 or Radeon RX 6700
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
